# DarkSlide v1.2.3

DarkSlide 1.2.3 improves conversion consistency and protects ongoing edits and exports. It includes the export reliability fixes from the unreleased 1.2.2 version.

## Highlights

- Full-resolution exports and contact sheets hold back preview rendering until they finish. Requests queued behind an export no longer terminate a healthy image worker, and a late cancellation cannot kill an in-flight export.
- Saved custom presets retain film-stock density calibration, color conversion, LUTs, light-source settings, and lab style. Saving a preset leaves the active document and its unsaved-edit status intact.
- Dust-repair coordinates stay with their source image instead of being copied into reusable presets. Presets saved without framing preserve the target image's crop, rotation, and leveling when applied.
- Each RAW image keeps its own import recipe. RAW startup no longer applies film-base color compensation twice, and automatic film-base estimates retain their confidence safeguards.
- Manual and shared film-base samples track their color profile, so switching output profiles preserves the reference correctly. Light-source correction now operates in linear transmittance and treats image pixels and film-base samples consistently.
- CPU rendering, GPU previews, and high-depth exports use matching high-resolution curve tables, reducing differences caused by intermediate rounding.
- Automatic and picked white balance use the converted image and the same slider math, account for lab-style temperature bias, and preserve over-range channel values when sampling.
- Auto adjustment, film-base re-analysis, and point picking discard stale results when edits change during analysis.
- Restoring a sidecar respects its saved profile, black-and-white settings, explicit film-base choice, and disabled light-source or lab-style selections.

## Desktop Downloads

GitHub Actions builds and attaches installers for each supported desktop platform:

- macOS: universal Apple Silicon and Intel `.dmg`
- Windows: `.msi` and NSIS `.exe`
- Linux: `.deb` and `.AppImage`

## Installation Notes

- macOS builds are not notarized. On first launch, macOS may require opening the app through System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
- Windows and Linux builds are unsigned.

## Validation

Type-checking, ESLint, all 579 tests across 51 test files, and the production web build passed before release. Regression coverage includes export coordination, preset recipes, RAW accuracy, curve consistency, white balance, stale analysis, and sidecar restoration.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kilianvivien/DarkSlide/compare/v1.2.1...v1.2.3
